watches.name: Kobold Timemaster Field Watch
watches.description: The Kobold Timemaster Field Watch features a Made in U.S.A. Kobold Kairos case designed by Kobold founding father and master watchmaker Gerd-R. Lang. The Swiss hand-wound movement has been modified to display central seconds. It is finely decorated with Cotes de Geneve (Geneva stripes) and engraved "Kobold Watch Co., Pittsburgh, PA." A screw balance and swan neck fine regulator complete the technically and aesthetically pleasing movement. The original Kairos case is best known for its coin-edge bezels (front and back). The Kobold Timemaster Field Watch features a re-designed version of this iconic case. fashioned from aerospace-grade titanium. The Kobold Timemaster Field Watch is the first watch featuring the Kairos case with more minimalist design queues - one of the last updates, designed by the legendary Gerd-R. Lang, who named this version "Goose." Kobold is proud to manufacture the redesigned Kairos case in the United States of America. Production will begin once 200 watches have been reserved. Koboldians committing to this unique model will receive within two weeks of placing their order a Kobold timepiece of greater value to use until the Kobold Timemaster Field Watch ships. Koboldians living in the greater Pittsburgh or New York City area may receive their watches via hand delivery. The Kobold Timemaster Field Watch comes with a ten-year warranty. It arrives on a calfskin strap with signed and screw-locked buckle, in a genuine leather Kobold travel pouch. Case: Kobold "Kairos" case aerospace-grade titanium sapphire crystal, domed, anti-reflective (front) sapphire crystal, plane (back) screw-down crown screw-locked caseback 44.5mm diameter 13.5mm height 22mm between lugs (strap size) water resistant to 10 atmospheres (100 meters/330 feet) Movement: Unitas 6497 (Swiss Made), modified with central seconds hand, hand-wound

watches.name: Kobold Limits
watches.description: In 2026, Kobold endeavors to once again bring back U.S. watch manufacturing in its hometown of Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. This includes producing watch cases in-house using modern CNC technology. To raise capital for this project, Kobold is unveiling a number of extremely competitively priced timepieces. In 2008, Kobold launched the first U.S.-made timepiece in over 39 years when it unveiled the Kobold Spirit of America, featuring a case entirely made in USA, in the process catapulting Kobold to the forefront of U.S. watch manufacturing. In 2014, Kobold built on this success by becoming the first U.S. watch brand in generations to produce its cases in-house. Following a number of calamities that severely affected the operations of Kobold USA, the CNC shop was shuttered. After a new team was assembled, the brand began the rebuilding effort.Now it is time to firmly re-establish Kobold as the leader in U.S. watch manufacturing. The new Kobold Limits timepiece features a 42.5-mm case in the post-modern style. It is equipped with an internal rotating bezel that is operated via a screw-down crown. A second screw-down crown enables the wearer to set the time. The Kobold Limits arrives on a natural rubber strap with screw-locked, signed buckle. A leather Kobold travel pouch completes the ensemble. The Limits sold at a steep discount support the effort to locate and help Sir Ranulph Fiennes is covered by a 2-year warranty against material defects and inferior workmanship. Specifications: Case: Kobold "Limits" case surgical-grade (316L) stainless steel DLC-coated black or tan coating (optional) sapphire crystal, plane, anti-reflective screw-down crowns screw-locked caseback 42.5mm diameter 14mm height 22mm between lugs (strap size) water resistant to 30 atmospheres (300 meters/1,000 feet) Movement: ETA 2824 (Swiss Made)

watches.name: Kobold Globetrotter
watches.description: The Kobold Globetrotter is powered by an automatic-winding movement, the Forester F. 197. This movement was created in 1970 and at the time was the slimmest German-made mechanical movement. The movement is new old stock (NOS) and has never been used in a finished watch. The Kobold Globetrotter case was designed by Gerd-R. Lang and used in his iconic Orea collection of timepieces. The refined design queues and proportions of the Globetrotter case, combined with the classic display offered by the F,197 movement make the Kobold Globetrotter an ideal dress watch when worn on a leather strap. When worn on the Original Kobold Canvas Strap, the Globetrotter is the perfect companion for every day. Its luminous hour markers and hands are extremely bright thanks to the Swiss Made SuperLuminova compound. Following the passing of its founding father, master watchmaker Gerd-R. Lang, Kobold secured Mr. Lang's archive and case making tools, as well as a large quantity of vintage cases and movements from the 1920s, 1940s, 1950s and 1970s. To honor Mr. Lang and his significant contribution to the field of horology, Kobold is releasing a number of limited edition watches he envisioned but never completed or designed but did not bring to market. The Kobold Globetrotter is available to existing Kobold Watch customers at only $750. How can we afford to do this? In 2004, Kobold acquired over 4,000 Forster movements. These movements have not been utilised except in rare circumstances, for example in the Kobold Spirit of America Automatic released in 2008. As a result, these movements have been fully depreciated. In 2024, Kobold acquired over 10,000 movements that are even more coveted and rare than the F.197. Finally, in 2026, Kobold endeavors to acquire its new manufacturing facility in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania - home of the Kobold line of watches. So what better way to fundraise than to blow out 4,000+ Globetrotters at a mind-blowing $750? The Globetrotter arrives on Kobold's Original Canvas Expedition Strap. The watch is covered by a 10-year warranty against material defects and inferior workmanship. *** The first production run of the Globetrotter is sold out. The next production run ships in October 2026. *** Specifications: Case: Original Gerd-R. Lang-designed case surgical-grade (316L) stainless steel sapphire crystal, plane (front and back) screw-down crown screw-locked caseback screw-locked lug bars 37mm diameter 14mm height 18mm between lugs (strap size) water resistant to 3 atmospheres (30 meters/100 feet) Movement: Foerster F.197 (German Made), automatic winding (New Old Stock, reconditioned)

watches.name: Kobold Globetrotter Triple Calendar
watches.description: Introducing an iconic timepiece: The Kobold Globetrotter Triple Calendar. Powered by a manual-winding movement, the Kobold Globetrotter displays the day, date, month as well as the phase of the moon. Its movement is the extremely rare Valjoux 89 from 1940. The movement is new old stock (NOS) and has never been used in a finished watch. The Kobold Globetrotter case was designed by Gerd-R. Lang and used in his iconic Orea collection of timepieces. The refined design queues and proportions of the Globetrotter case, combined with the classic display offered by the Valjoux 89 movement make the Kobold Globetrotter an ideal dress watch when worn on a leather strap. When worn on the Original Kobold Canvas Strap, the Globetrotter is the perfect companion for every day. The Kobold Globetrotter Triple Calendar is available to existing Kobold Watch customers at only $3,000. This presents an extraordinary opportunity to acquire a unique timepiece with an extremely rare movement. Following the passing of its founding father, master watchmaker Gerd-R. Lang, Kobold secured Mr. Lang's archive and case making tools, as well as a large quantity of vintage cases and movements from the 1920s, 1940s, 1950s and 1970s. To honor Mr. Lang and his significant contribution to the field of horology, Kobold is releasing a number of limited edition watches he envisioned but never completed or designed but did not bring to market. The Kobold Globetrotter Triple Calendar ships in March 2026. Customer who place an order for this watch will receive a Kobold Spirit of America, Kobold Seal or Kobold Soarway Diver as a loaner watch within two weeks. The loaner watch may be worn and returned to Kobold in used condition at the time that the Globetrotter Triple Calendar ships. The Globetrotter Triple Calendar arrives on Kobold's Original Canvas Expedition Strap. A calfskin strap and Kobold leather watch pouch complete the ensemble. The watch is covered by a 10-year warranty against material defects and inferior workmanship. Specifications: Case: Original Gerd-R. Lang-designed case surgical-grade (316L) stainless steel sapphire crystal, plane (front and back) screw-down crown screw-locked caseback screw-locked lug bars 37mm diameter 11mm height 18mm between lugs (strap size) water resistant to 3 atmospheres (30 meters/100 feet) Movement: ETA 89 (Swiss Made), manual winding (New Old Stock, reconditioned)

watches.name: Kobold Professional Chronograph II
watches.description: Introducing the Kobold Professional Chronograph, equipped with a rare and extremely slim hand wound chronograph caliber Valjoux 7760 and an original, new-old-stock vintage 1970s case. The movement of this limited edition was modified to display the sundials in the traditional tri-compax style, its subdials being at the 3, 6 and 9 o'clock positions. Only 100 pieces are available and as part of Kobold's celebrations of 25th anniversary, is made available at an exceptionally low price. A uni-directional rotating bezel with a count-up minute scale make this timepiece ideal for pilots. Following the passing of its founding father, master watchmaker Gerd-R. Lang, Kobold secured Mr. Lang's archive and case making tools, as well as a large quantity of vintage cases and movements from the 1920s, 1940s, 1950s and 1970s. To honor Mr. Lang and his significant contribution to the field of horology, Kobold is releasing a number of limited edition watches he envisioned but never completed or designed but did not bring to market. The Kobold Professional ships in April 2026. Customer who place an order for this watch will receive a Kobold Seal or Kobold Soarway Diver as a loaner watch within two weeks. The loaner watch may be worn and returned to Kobold in used condition at the time that the Professional Chronograph ships. The Professional Chronograph arrives on Kobold's Original Canvas Expedition Strap. The watch is covered by a 10-year warranty against material defects and inferior workmanship. watches.name: Kairos Gerd-R. Lang Chronograph
watches.description: The upcoming Kobold Kairos Gerd-R. Lang Chronograph - a limited edition of 100 watches - is now available for pre-order. Paying homage to the great master watchmaker and Kobold founding father Gerd-R. Lang, this eponymous wrist instrument features Lang's iconic Kairos case and an automatic-winding Swiss Made movement. This fine chronograph's dial and blued steel hands are both luminous and are inspired by 1940s military chronographs. Handmade Louisiana alligator strap, signed and screw-locked buckle. ***Watches begin shipping in December 2025*** Specifications: Case: surgical-grade (316L) stainless steel sapphire crystal, domed, anti-reflective (front) sapphire crystal, flat (back) screw-down crown screw-locked caseback screw-locked lug bars 38mm diameter 16mm height 20mm between lugs (strap size) water resistant to 10 atmospheres (100 meters/330 feet) Movement: ETA Valjoux 7750, modified (Swiss Made)

watches.name: Soarway Transglobe
watches.description: Seasoned world travelers, foreign service officers and members of the military may find the Soarway Transglobe a suitable companion for their exploits in faraway places like Nepal, India, or Afghanistan, where time zones are 30 or even 45 minutes apart, instead of the full hour to which the Western world has become accustomed. The Transglobe displays the time in a second time zone in hours and minutes, making it easy to tell the time in exotic locations while keeping track of the time in the wearer's home country. In addition, the Soarway Transglobe features a day/night indicator that is synced to the second time zone. This little function is useful when determining whether it's too early or too late to phone home. For individuals who don't enjoy globetrotting, the Transglobe is still a useful timepiece. By simply setting the second time indicator to "12:00" turns the Transglobe into a useful stopwatch for all manner of activities, from running to cooking, from parking to rehearsing a speech. The Soarway Transglobe is a multi-purpose watch powered by a modified ETA caliber 2892-A2 (K.793). Far more than a simple modification, this movement is almost completely redeveloped by Kobold and represents our greatest horological achievement. This modification was made possible through the collaboration of Kobold's U.S.-based watchmakers and U.S.-based mechanical engineers along with a renowned Swiss movement supplier (the movement is made in Switzerland). Limited Edition of 100 watches in a 316L stainless steel case and 100 watches in a case fashioned from aerospace-grade titanium. The Soarway Transglobe arrives on Kobold's Original Canvas Expedition Strap. (stainless steel bracelet optional). The watch is covered by a 10-year warranty against material defects and inferior workmanship. ***The stainless steel version of the Soarway Transglobe will ship in Q4/'25. Titanium version ships in Q2/'26. *** *** NOTE: Product images show the dial marked "Made in Nepal". Actual watch ships with dial marked "Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania"***

watches.name: Kobold Cabriolet
watches.description: Originally designed in the late 1920s, the reversible case of the Kobold Cabriolet is a true horological novelty. Updated and patented by Kobold founding father and master watchmaker Gerd-Ruediger Lang in the early 1990s, this case features a mechanism that allows the wearer to flip the case around 180 degrees, thus exposing the screw-locked caseback while hiding the delicate front of the watch, with its sapphire crystal and Art Deco style solid silver or lacquered dial. The improved version of this iconic convertible timepiece features a water-resistant design, making the Kobold Cabriolet a true sports watch. Its case is by far the costliest in Kobold Watch history and we're naturally very proud that a patent for its unique design is pending. Powered by a high precision Swiss Made automatic movement or a Swiss quartz movement, the Kobold Cabriolet is available from November 2025. 10 years warranty. Ships in a Kobold travel pouch. ***Due to trademark regulations, the Kobold Cabriolet is only available to residents of the United States of America.*** Case: Stainless steel 316L Dimensions: 43mm x 27mm x 9mm Crystal: Sapphire (front and back) Movement: ETA 2670, automatic-winding // ETA 901, quartz

watches.name: Kobold Seal Ceramic 25th Anniversary Edition
watches.description: The latest iteration of the iconic, James Gandolfini-designed Kobold Seal marks our brand's 25th anniversary. The white ceramic midcase of the Kobold Seal Ceramic 25th Anniversary Edition is completed by a titanium bezel with ceramic inlay, as well as a titanium caseback. The meteorite dial is emblazoned with the name of the late actor and Kobold brand ambassador who created the Seal - James Gandolfini. The Kobold Seal Ceramic comes with a black and a white natural rubber strap and a signed, screw-locked folding clasp. Limited edition of 25 watches. The Seal Ceramic 25th Anniversary Edition is covered by a 10-year warranty.

watches.name: Kobold Seal 25th Anniversary Edition
watches.description: At Kobold, we want to invite our most loyal supporters to join the celebration. Introducing the Kobold Seal 25th Anniversary Edition. When James Gandolfini designed the original Seal, he had a hunch that this watch would become iconic. After inspecting the first prototype, he said "you should make this part of your regular line. I think it's a winner." Michael Kobold didn't share his friend's enthusiasm for the bulky, oversized watch. James Gandolfini doubled down on his request that the Seal go into serial production: "Build it, my German friend, this watch will sell. I will do an ad campaign to help you promote it." The rest, as they say, is history. James Gandolfini did end up appearing in a full-page, nationwide advertising campaign in which he extended his middle finger in the direction of the camera. The campaign's slogan: "Even James Gandolfini Thinks Kobold Is Number 1." Since then, thousands of Kobold Seals have been built, making it the #1 bestselling Kobold timepiece. Today, Kobold is proud to unveil a very special version of this iconic watch: The Kobold Seal 25th Anniversary Edition. Its Soarway case is fashioned from Grade 5 aerospace-grade titanium. An extra thick sapphire crystal protects the meteorite dial emblazoned with the name of the Seal's creator. Limited to only 25 watches. The Seal 25th Anniversary Edition is covered by a 10-year warranty.

watches.name: Rattrapante Chronograph
watches.description: The upcoming Kobold Rattrapante Chronograph - a limited edition of 100 watches - is now available for pre-order. The Rattrapante's dial is made from solid silver, the hands are blued steel - both are original stock from the later Kobold founding father and master watchmaker Gerd-R. Lang (Kobold only re-prints the dials, they are vintage 1992). The movement features Gerd-R. Lang's famous patented rattrapante (split seconds) complication (base caliber Valjoux 7750). Handmade Louisiana alligator strap, signed and screw-locked buckle. ***INTRODUCTORY OFFER ONLY! Watches begin shipping in October 2025*** The introductory offer is available to 25 existing Kobold watch customers and 10 new Kobold watch customers. Specifications: Case: surgical-grade (316L) stainless steel sapphire crystal, domed, anti-reflective (front) sapphire crystal, flat (back) screw-down crown screw-locked caseback screw-locked lug bars 38mm diameter 16mm height 20mm between lugs (strap size) water resistant to 10 atmospheres (100 meters/330 feet) Movement: ETA Valjoux 7750, modified (Swiss Made)

watches.name: Kobold Régulateur Handwound
watches.description: Currently in development as part of the Kobold 25th anniversary celebrations, the Kobold Regulateur Handwound is the latest Kobold timepiece featuring the iconic 19-component watch case by Gerd-R. Lang, the late master watchmaker and Kobold founding father. The Kobold Regulateur features classic proportions and is powered by a modified Swiss-made caliber Unitas 6450, which can be viewed through the exhibition caseback. The timepiece's regulator-style dial displays hours at the 12 o'clock position, minutes from the center and seconds at the 6 o'clock position. This unique design was made popular in 1987 when Gerd-R. Lang unveiled his iconic Regulateur Handwound, the first serially produced wristwatch featuring this dial layout. The watch quickly sold out and became a highly sought-after collectible. Kobold is paying homage to its late founding father with this re-edition, using Gerd-R. Lang's original case drawings and tooling dies, as well as vintage movements acquired by Gerd R.-Lang. Dial colors available: Silver, Deep Black, Arctic Blue and Copper. The Kobold Regulateur Handwound is covered by a 2 year warranty. The watch arrives in a calfskin travel pouch and on a calfskin strap with signed, screw-locked buckle. Limited edition of 400 watches. ***Available for reservation only, delivery late-2025. Customers are charged once the watch is ready to ship. Limit of one watch per customer/order.*** Specifications: Case: surgical-grade (316L) stainless steel sapphire crystal, flat, anti-reflective (front) sapphire crystal, flat (back) screw-down crown screw-locked caseback screw-locked lug bars 38mm diameter 10mm height 20mm between lugs (strap size) water resistant to 10 atmospheres (100 meters/330 feet) Movement: Unitas 6450 (Swiss Made)

watches.name: Richard E. Byrd II
watches.description: To celebrate its 25th anniversary, Kobold is making its commemorative timepiece available at an earth-shatteringly low introductory price. The all-new Kobold Richard E. Byrd II timepiece features an iconic case designed by the late master watchmaker Gerd-Ruediger Lang. The case was invented in 1983 and consists of 19 individual components, including screw-locked lug bars and an iconic onion crown. As one of the four Kobold founding fathers, Gerd-R. Lang was a true genius and the inventor of iconic watch case of which Kobold today possesses all of the original tooling, dies and technical drawings. The Kobold Richard E. Byrd II is housed in a 40mm-version of Lang's case, which features a sapphire crystal in the front, as well as a sapphire crystal exhibition casebakc through which the Swiss-made ETA 2824 automatic-winding movement can be viewed. The handmade luminous dial is available in the following colors: Deep Black, Arctic Blue and Copper. Luminous cathedral hands ensure perfect legibility even in poor lighting conditions. The watch arrives on a canvas strap with signed, screw-locked buckle, inside a Kobold leather watch pouch. The watch is covered by a 2-year warranty against material defects and inferior workmanship. The Kobold Richard E. Byrd II is available now and ships within 2 weeks from the time of order. An optional stainless steel bracelet is available on request. Specifications: Case: surgical-grade (316L) stainless steel sapphire crystal, domed, anti-reflective (front) sapphire crystal, flat (back) screw-down crown screw-locked caseback screw-locked lug bars 40mm diameter 11mm height 20mm between lugs (strap size) water resistant to 10 atmospheres (100 meters/330 feet) Movement: ETA 2824 (Swiss Made)

watches.name: Soarway Diver Seal Monobloc
watches.description: The Seal Monobloc is the first all-new rendition of the iconic diver's watch designed by James Gandolfini. The Seal Monobloc's name is a nod to the ubiquitous white resin lawn chair, which the large-framed James Gandolfini has been known to obliterate - not in anger or frustration, but just by merely sitting in one! "Seal" because when its famous and corpulent creator swam along the New Jersey Shore, he would strike an uncanny resemblance to the marine mammal. Thankfully, unlike the lawn chair, the Seal Monobloc is virtually indestructible, and it can hold its own in the water. That's because the Seal Monobloc is a real tool watch and shares most of its components with its costlier (and much heavier) stainless steel and titanium cousins. Its 43mm diameter case measures 16.5mm in height, and features an extra-thick, domed sapphire crystal, threaded crown, and threaded caseback, allowing a depth rating of 100 meters. An automatic-winding Swiss movement (ETA-2824) powers this hefty diver's watch. For optimal legibility in darkness, Swiss SuperLuminova luminous compound is applied generously to the hands and to the dial's hour markers. The Seal Monobloc's strap is secured to the case with a pair of screw-locked lug bars. A screw-locked stainless steel buckle prevents the Seal from inadvertently coming off your wrist. The Seal is the most iconic Kobold watch. Designed by James Gandolfini, the late actor and Kobold brand ambassador, the original Seal has been in production since 2004. Often imitated but never successfully copied, the legendary Seal has a striking look thanks to its oversized rotating bezel and small face. Of course, you'll be asked by awe-struck strangers to take it off your wrist for a closer inspection. That's when the Seal's many intricate design queues, such a the beveled edges on its lugs and its heft will impress even the most avid watch aficionados. There's nothing quite like the Seal. The Soarway Diver Seal Monobloc arrives on an original Kobold diver's strap with signed fittings and signed, screw-locked buckle. The watch is covered by a 2-year warranty against material defects and inferior workmanship. ***The introductory offer on the Seal Monobloc ends on August 1, 2026. Thereafter, the regular price of $2,250 will be in effect.*** Specifications: Case: Kobold "Soarway" case high-impact resin ("Gandolfini-proof") sapphire crystal, domed, anti-reflective, extra-thick screw-down crown screw-locked caseback 43.5mm diameter 17mm height 22mm between lugs (strap size) water resistant to 10 atmospheres (100 meters/330 feet) Movement: ETA 2824 (Swiss Made), automatic-winding

watches.name: SMG-2
watches.description: If you prefer a lighter, more compact GMT watch, the SMG-2 is made for you. It is just as versatile as its big brother, the Soarway GMT but doesn’t have the bulk. An independent hour hand indicates the time at home while the main hour and minute hands display local time. Canvas strap. The watch is covered by a 10-year warranty against material defects and inferior workmanship. Specifications: Case: Kobold "Soarway" case surgical-grade (316L) stainless steel DLC-coated black coating (optional) sapphire crystal, domed, anti-reflective screw-down crown screw-locked caseback 43.5mm diameter 15mm height 22mm between lugs (strap size) water-resistant to 20 atmospheres (6600 feet/200 meters) Movement: ETA 2893 (Swiss Made), automatic-winding

watches.name: Phantom Black Ops
watches.description: The Phantom Black Ops is an aptly-named wrist instrument for silent professionals. Its green luminous hands and hour markers make it highly legible while wearing night vision goggles. In case you don't regularly use night vision goggles as part of your daily routine, you probably aren't a SEAL. No matter, you can use the Phantom Black Ops to do a number of other important jobs, like timing your dinner with the bi-directional rotating bezel. No matter in which environment you use the Phantom Black Ops, you can count on its rugged dependability and super sleek design to keep you thrilled. The men of the U.S. Navy SEALs who wear this stealthy watch are not issued a Kobold, they each choose to own one individually. Kobold makes this possible by giving SEALs and other service members a healthy discount in recognition of the sacrifices they make. The Phantom Black Ops arrives on Kobold's Original Canvas Expedition Strap. Stainless steel or titanium bracelet (DLC-coated) optional. The watch is covered by a 10-year warranty against material defects and inferior workmanship. watches.name: Polar Surveyor Chronograph
watches.description: The Polar Surveyor Chronograph is a truly legendary wristwatch. Created originally with the help of explorer Sir Ranulph Fiennes and master watchmaker Gerd-R. Lang, it has been in production since 2003. It took no fewer than two years to create the final prototype before the two men gave their protege -Kobold Watch Co. founder Michel Kobold- their respective nods of approval. The Polar Surveyor Chronograph was designed from the ground up. A new, purpose-builtcase was developed to house the intricate mechanical movement. This case was later dubbed Soarway case and today forms the backbone of an entire collection of Kobold wrist instruments. The Polar Surveyor displays GMT, the date and chronograph functions. When it was unveiled, the Polar Surveyor was the world's first automatic-winding watch to incorporate all these functions. Powered by a modified Swiss-made ETA caliber 7750 (K.715). Available in a 316L stainless steel or aerospace-grade titanium case. The Polar Surveyor Chronograph arrives on Kobold's Original Canvas Expedition Strap. (Stainless steel or aerospace-grade titanium bracelet optional.) The Polar Surveyor Chronograph sold at a steep discount support the effort to locate and help Sir Ranulph Fiennes is covered by a 2-year warranty against material defects and inferior workmanship. Limited production of 10 watches per year. watches.name: Arctic Diver
watches.description: The Arctic Diver, along with the iconic Seal, is the toughest and most reliable Kobold watch ever built. Its 44.5mm stainless steel Soarway case features and extra-thick, domed sapphire crystal, a triple-sealed, screw-locked crown and an extra-thick stainless steel caseback. An internal secondary case made from soft-iron shields the Swiss-made automatic movement from magnetic interference (up to 80,000 A/m). The case finish is DLC-coated black. In 2020, Kobold introduced a new version of the Arctic Diver with aerospace-grade titanium as there material for the outer case. This reduces the total weight of the hefty Arctic Diver considerably and improves comfort. The titanium version is available in two finishes: DLC-coated black or mirror polished, a novelty among titanium watches offered exclusively by Kobold. The Arctic Diver comes on a signed nylon strap. A signed natural rubber strap is available on request. The watch is covered by a 10-year warranty against material defects and inferior workmanship. watches.name: Fire Truck Expedition - Berlin to Kathmandu
watches.description: Experience one of the last great adventures: An overland expedition through Europe and Asia in a German firefighting vehicle. This 45-day journey spans over 7,500 miles (12,000 kilometers) and traverses Germany, Austria, Hungary, Serbia, Bulgaria, Turkey, Iran, Pakistan and India before reaching Nepal. Past expedition team members have termed this "the adventure of a lifetime". The Fire Truck Expedition will visit cultural heritage sites in Berlin and in the Bavarian alps, tour Salzburg and Budapest, explore well-preserved Roman ruins, enter an active excavation site of an 8,000-year-old temple structure, visit several UNESCO World Heritage Sites in Iran, see an an ancient fortress along the Pakistan-Afghanistan border, sight-see the Red Fort of New Delhi and enter off-the beaten-path cultural and architectural gems in the former Himalayan kingdom of Nepal. Link: Smithsonian Magazine: Gobekli Tepe - The World's First Temple? Accommodations include some of the finest 5-star boutique hotels in Europe and Asia, a police cell in Pakistan (for security only; private accommodation guaranteed), as well as the majestic Hyatt Regency Kathmandu. The expedition consists of several firefighting vehicles as well as several support vehicles. Team members will have the opportunity to drive the firefighting vehicles (accompanied by a professional driver) and to rest in the support vehicles. Individuals suffering from vertigo are welcome to join the expedition and can opt out of any high-altitude activities. In Turkey and Nepal, the expedition reaches heights between 4,000 and 13,000 feet (1,500 - 4,000 meters) and team members will have the opportunity to ride in a hot air balloon over Cappadocia, Turkey and in a helicopter into the Himalayas of Nepal. Link: Nepali Times: German Fire Trucks For Nepal The Fire Truck Expedition is the brainchild of Michael Kobold and the late actor James Gandolfini. Conceived in 2011, the expedition remained a dream for over a decade - beset by geopolitical instability, natural disasters, an economic blockade of Nepal (by India), a pandemic, as well as not least the passing of James Gandolfini himself. Yet in October 2022, the Fire Truck Expedition finally got underway for the first time, departing Berlin in October and arriving in Kathmandu with much fanfare in late November. This excursion includes all accommodations, meals, transport (including domestic private air travel) and permit fees. Visa fees and costs related to vaccinations are not included. Tours available in March, April, October and November. Limited to six participants. Price reflects six participants and increases with fewer participants.

watches.description: The all-new Phantom SL Avantgarde is the world's most lightweight mechanical-winding, professional-grade tool watch. Its sleek Soarway case is made from lightweight aerospace-grade titanium with a polished finish. A further weight reduction is achieved by skeletonizing the chronograph movement that powers the Phantom SL Avantgarde. "SL" stands for SuperLight. The Phantom SL Avantgarde is so light, in fact, that after you put this toolwatch on your wrist, after a few moments you barely know it's there anymore. For collectors, the Phantom SL Avantgarde features a skeletonized dial and a sapphire crystal exhibition back, which allow a direct view into the watch's skeleton movement. This watch is limited to only 50 pieces. The Phantom SL Avantgarde arrives on a natural rubber strap and ships with a separate alligator strap. A polished titanium bracelet is optional. The watch is covered by a 10-year warranty against material defects and inferior workmanship. watches.name: Himalaya Everest Edition II
watches.description: The Himalaya Everest Edition HW features a dial fashioned from a piece of rock collected just below the summit of Mount Everest. The dial is more than three times as thick as regular dial and contributes a significant amount to the weight of the watch. To offset this weight increase, the new Himalaya Everest Edition II has a case made from polished aerospace-grade titanium. (An 18K rose gold case is available on request.) A normal dial has a thickness of between 0.2mm and 0.4mm. The Everest rock has a thickness of 1.0mm. In order to fit the substantially thicker piece of Everest rock onto the dial plate, Kobold subcontracted the operations of cutting, slicing, grinding and polishing the pieces of rock to a German firm specializing in this work. The German experts faced challenges along the way but after almost two years, we finally held the first Everest dial in our hands. The result was amazing and our customers agreed - the first run of 25 automatic-winding Himalaya Everest Edition watches sold out in a short amount of time. In 2021, Kobold began developing the Himalaya Everest Edition II. The new watch is powered by a hand wound Swiss-made Unitas 6497 caliber that has been modified to include a central seconds hand and to accommodate the unique thickness of the dial with the Everest summit rock. The Himalaya Everest Edition arrives on Kobold's Original Canvas Expedition Strap. The watch is covered by a 10-year warranty against material defects and inferior workmanship. Specifications: Case: Kobold Intrepid case aerospace-grade titanium or 18K rose gold sapphire crystal, domed, anti-reflective screw-locked caseback 43.5mm diameter 13mm height 22mm between lugs (strap size) water resistant to 10 atmospheres (100 meters/330 feet) Movement: ETA 2824 (Swiss Made), automatic-winding or UNITAS 6497 (Swiss Made), hand-wound, modified with central seconds The Back Story In 2009 and 2010, Kobold-founder Michael Kobold reached the summit of Mount Everest and collected a number of rocks a few yards below the summit, on the Nepal side of the mountain. Initially, these rocks were intended as gifts for friends and family. After returning from the expedition, a Nepali goldsmith fashioned a ring featuring a small piece of the summit rock, which Michael presented to his future wife and fellow Everest summiteer, Anita. It was then that the idea was born to turn some of the rocks into watch dials. The first run of Himalaya Everest Edition watches was limited to 25 pieces, which sold out soon after Kobold opened its flagship store in Kathmandu. This edition, however, had a design problem. The dial was too thick to accommodate even the highest hand height available on a Swiss movement (height #4), causing the hour hand to touch the dial. The result was that most of the first edition watches failed in the field. Despite this recurring problem, some of the original Himalaya Everest watches have sold for substantially more than the $16,500 list price. In 2012 at a watch auction in London, one of these unique watches changed owners for GBP 25,000. The new Himalaya Everest Edition II has overcome the teething problems of the earlier edition. By substantially increasing the hand height of the movement, the "HimEvII" has adequate clearance between the dial and the hands and is therefore not only a ruggedly beautiful showpiece, but a reliable and accurate timekeeper as well.

watches.name: NEC 5326 - the Navy SEAL Watch
watches.description: Our ties to the SEAL community go back to the company's early beginnings and over the course of the past 25 years have become much stronger. The Kobold NEC 5326 honors our amphibian friends by unveiling a watch that is made just for them. The NEC 5326 is not the first Kobold that is unavailable to civilians, but it is the first watch made exclusively for Navy SEALs. Its main feature is the renowned Soarway case fashioned from aerospace-grade titanium. The case is a tiny time vault that has proven itself downrange on countless occasions and available in three finishes: non-coated, Tactical (DLC-coated black), and Safari (DLC-coated tan). A civilian version of the NEC 5326 GMT, complete with a bright orange GMT hand, is available on request. The watch is available with a black date wheel or a white date wheel. The NEC 5326 and the NEC 5326 GMT arrive on Kobold's Original Canvas Expedition Strap. The watch is covered by a 10-year warranty against material defects and inferior workmanship. There is currently a short waitlist for the NEC 5326. Starting in July 2026, the watch ships within 4-6 weeks from the date of order. Specifications: Case: Kobold "Soarway" case aerospace-grade titanium DLC-coated black or tan (optional) sapphire crystal, domed, anti-reflective screw-down crown screw-locked caseback 43.5mm diameter 15mm height 22mm between lugs (strap size) water-resistant to 20 atmospheres (660 feet/200 meters) Movement: ETA 2892 (Swiss Made), automatic winding ETA 2893 (Swiss Made), automatic winding, GMT function

Its features and functions are identical to the non-DLC coated Soarway Diver but its looks are unique and inspire a sense of adventure. Available with a California dial (pictured above) or with regular hour markers. The regular dial version features the words "Soarway Diver" printed in orange and is complemented by a matching seconds hand (see "Gallery" for more). The Soarway Diver Safari arrives on Kobold's canvas expedition strap. The watch is covered by a 10-year warranty against material defects and inferior workmanship. ***The Soarway Diver Safari has an 8-week delivery timeframe from the date of receipt of order.*** Production limited to 25 pieces per year. watches.name: Nepal Fire Truck Expedition Timekeeper
watches.description: In November 2022, Kobold organised a g rand adventure in the tradition of past Kobold-sponsored exploits: The Nepal Fire Truck Expedition. The expedition covered over 12,000 kilometers (7,500 miles) between Berlin and Kathmandu and traversed hostile, terrorism-plagued regions in eastern Turkey and along the Pakistan-Afghanistan border. The expedition also entered Iran at the height of the protest movement. In Nepal, the expedition criss-crossed the country, stopping in remote regions in the Himalayas and at UNESCO World Heritage sites. Conceived in 2011 by Michael Kobold and the late actor and Kobold brand ambassador James Gandolfini, the Fire Truck Expedition is a cornerstone of the Kobold ethos - Embrace Adventure. All worthwhile pursuits are littered with obstacles and the fire truck expedition has seen its share - geopolitical machinations, natural disasters, inter-governmental rivalries, attempted bribe-taking and much more! At Kobold, we are proud of our commitment to Nepal. The ancient city of Kathmandu, along with Pittsburgh and Berlin, is one of three homes of the Kobold brand of watches and expedition tools. In 2024, Kobold sent one additional firefighting vehicle to a community in Nepal, again via an overland expedition mostly tracing the route of the 2022 expedition. The next overland expedition is planned for 2026. Stay tuned for more! Koboldians who support this cause by purchasing the Fire Truck Expedition Timekeeper receive a $250 credit towards the purchase of Kobold accessories (straps, leather accessories, etc.) or out-of-warranty service. Thank you for your consideration! The Fire Truck Expedition Timekeeper is covered by a Non-transferrable Lifetime Warranty - "If it breaks, we replace it!"

It is powered by a Swiss automatic-winding movement (the Law Enforcement version is powered by an automatic-winding movement Made in Japan). Canvas strap. 10 year warranty. watches.name: Pandemonium
watches.description: The Pandemonium, America's first fully skeletonized chronograph, was designed and produced in collaboration with master watchmaker Gerd-Ruediger Lang, one of the Founding Fathers of Kobold. The Pandemonium is a genuine work of art and is an example of mechanical watchmaking at its finest. At the core of the Pandemonium lies its carefully skeletonized, automatic-winding chronograph movement. The beautifully finished bridges are rhodium plated and feature perlage pattern decoration. In order to obstruct the movement as little as possible, Kobold modified the Pandemonium's movement to display the date out of the center. In addition, the chronograph sub-dials for minutes and hours have been omitted. However, the chronograph's mechanical function remains fully intact, so that the Pandemonium gives its wearer a look into the inner workings of this horological complication. The Pandemonium is by far the most ambitious watch Kobold has ever produced. It ranks right up there with the Kobold Polar Surveyor Chronograph and the Kobold Soarway Transglobe in terms of ingenuity. Yet the flawless execution of this masterpiece requires an even greater set of skills. The Pandemonium arrives on a genuine Louisiana alligator strap. The watch is covered by a 10-year warranty against material defects and inferior workmanship. ***The Pandemonium has an 4-month delivery timeframe from the date of receipt of order.*** Specifications: Case: Kobold "Intrepid" case surgical-grade (316L) stainless steel sapphire crystal, domed, anti-reflective, extra-thick screw-down crown screw-locked caseback 43.5mm diameter 17mm height 22mm between lugs (strap size) water resistant to 10 atmospheres (100 meters/330 feet) Movement: ETA 7750 (Swiss Made) skeletonized

watches.name: Soarway Diver Seal
watches.description: The Seal is the most iconic Kobold watch. Designed by James Gandolfini, the late actor and Kobold brand ambassador, the Seal has been in production since 2004. Often imitated but never successfully copied, the legendary Seal has a striking look thanks to its oversized rotating bezel and small face. The heft of the Seal is due to its bulk -43mm diameter and 17mm height- and its internal soft iron core, which protects its Swiss automatic-winding mechanism from the effects of magnetism. The Seal is also equipped with a secondary shock absorption system that is part of the case. Its strap is secured to the solid stainless steel case with a pair of screw-locked lug bars. A screw-locked stainless steel buckle prevents the Seal from inadvertently coming off your wrist. Of course, you'll be asked by awe-struck strangers to take it off for a closer inspection. That's when the Seal's many intricate design queues, such a the beveled edges on its lugs and the hand-applied brushed surface finish, will impress even the most avid watch aficionados. There's nothing quite like the Seal. The Soarway Diver Seal arrives on Kobold's Original Canvas Expedition Strap. The Seal sold at a steep discount support the effort to locate and help Sir Ranulph Fiennes is covered by a 2-year warranty against material defects and inferior workmanship. ***The Seal in stainless steel and in titanium is always in stock. Military orders are custom-built and take 4-6 weeks to ship.*** Specifications: Case: Kobold "Soarway" case surgical-grade (316L) stainless steel DLC-coated black coating (optional) sapphire crystal, domed, anti-reflective, extra-thick screw-down crown screw-locked caseback 43.5mm diameter 17mm height 22mm between lugs (strap size) water resistant to 100 atmospheres (1,000 meters/3,300 feet) Optional: We offer the Seal in a number of custom bezel executions. Please inquire with us for details. Movement: ETA 2824 (Swiss Made), automatic-winding

watches.description: The Lynx, with its 36mm case and a dial made from a piece of rock collected from the summit of Mount Everest, is the ideal size for men who prefer to wear traditional sized watches. The Lynx is available with either an automatic-winding movement or, upon request, a Swiss Made quartz movement. Stainless steel bracelet (alligator strap available). The watch is covered by a 10-year warranty against material defects and inferior workmanship. Specifications: Case: Kobold "Lynx" case surgical-grade (316L) stainless steel sapphire crystal, domed, anti-reflective screw-down crown screw-locked caseback 36mm diameter 10mm height 20mm between lugs (strap size) water-resistant to 10 atmospheres (330 feet/100 meters) Movement: ETA 2892 (Swiss Made) or Ronda 515 precision quartz

watches.name: Lynx
watches.description: The Lynx is a watch of classic proportions and styling. Its 36mm case is the ideal size for men who prefer to wear traditional sized watches. The hand-polished cushion-shaped case harmonizes perfectly with the minimalist dial and hands. Who needs a date aperture these days? That’s why PDA’s exist! The watch is covered by a 10-year warranty against material defects and inferior workmanship. Specifications: Case: Kobold "Lynx" case surgical-grade (316L) stainless steel sapphire crystal, domed, anti-reflective screw-down crown screw-locked caseback 36mm diameter 10mm height 20mm between lugs (strap size) water-resistant to 10 atmospheres (330 feet/100 meters) Movement: ETA 2892 (Swiss Made) or Ronda 515 precision quartz

watches.name: Sir Ernest Shackleton
watches.description: The Sir Ernest Shackleton Edition pays tribute to one of the greatest polar explorers of all times. The richness of the Shackleton's color palette complements its refined, anachronistic design queues. Powered by a Swiss Made automatic winding movement, the Kobold Sir Ernest Shackleton is housed in a 43.5mm version of the Intrepid case, with a scratch-resistant, domed sapphire crystal, screw-down crown and screw-locked caseback. The watch is covered by a 10-year warranty against material defects and faulty workmanship. ***The Sir Ernest Shackleton has an 8-12 week delivery timeframe from the date of receipt of order.*** Specifications: Case: Kobold "Intrepid" case surgical-grade (316L) stainless steel sapphire crystal, domed, anti-reflective screw-down crown screw-locked caseback 43.5mm diameter 13mm height 22mm between lugs (strap size) water resistant to 10 atmospheres (100 meters/330 feet) Movement: ETA 2824 (Swiss Made), automatic winding or on request Unitas 6497 (Swiss Made), modified with central seconds hand, hand-wound

watches.name: Langley Automatic & Langley GMT Automatic
watches.description: The Kobold Langley Automatic and Langley GMT Automatic pay tribute to Samuel Pierpont Langley, the great inventor, astronomer, aviation pioneer and timekeeper. The Langley GMT Automatic features a GMT function in observance of Langley’s contribution to the modern standard time system. T he dial proudly displays the birthplace of both the standard time signal and the Kobold brand itself: Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. The Langley Automatic and Langley GMT Automatic arrive on Kobold's Original Canvas Expedition Strap. The watch is covered by a 10-year warranty against material defects and inferior workmanship. ** Starting in July 2026, the Langley Automatic and Langley GMT Automatic ship within 4-6 weeks. ** Specifications: Case: Kobold "Soarway" case surgical-grade (316L) stainless steel DLC-coated black coating (optional) sapphire crystal, domed, anti-reflective screw-down crown screw-locked caseback 43.5mm diameter 15mm height 22mm between lugs (strap size) water-resistant to 20 atmospheres (660 feet/200 meters) Movement: ETA 2892 (Swiss Made), automatic winding ETA 2893 (Swiss Made), automatic winding, GMT function

watches.name: Intrepid Chronograph
watches.description: The first Kobold chronograph in a 44mm case, the Intrepid is a throwback to the chronographs of yesteryear. We designed it with a minimalist approach. In fact, the Intrepid Chronograph can only measure elapsed seconds. DLC-coated crown and push buttons (available without DLC coating on request). Powered by a Swiss Made automatic winding movement, the Kobold Intrepid Chronograph is housed in a 43.5mm version of the Intrepid case, with a scratch-resistant, domed sapphire crystal, screw-down crown and screw-locked caseback. The Intrepid Chronograph arrives on Kobold's Original Canvas Expedition Strap. The watch is covered by a 10-year warranty against material defects and inferior workmanship. Production limited to 25 watches per year. Specifications: Case: Kobold "Intrepid" case surgical-grade (316L) stainless steel sapphire crystal, domed, anti-reflective screw-down crown screw-locked caseback 43.5mm diameter 17mm height 22mm between lugs (strap size) water-resistant to 10 atmospheres (330 feet/100 meters) Movement: ETA 7750 (Swiss Made)

watches.name: Spirit of America Automatic
watches.description: In 2008 w e set out with a simple goal: to build the first serially produced American watch using as many U.S. made components as possible. The result became the first American watch in almost 40 years. The Spirit of America became Kobold's answer to the practice of shipping American manufacturing jobs overseas. In the process, we kicked off the renaissance of American watchmaking. Today, the Spirit of America is produced both in the U.S. and in Berlin, Germany - the city most synonymous with freedom, democracy and triumph over adversity. The Spirit of America arrives on a genuine calfskin stra p or a natural rubber strap and is available with an Arctic Blue or Deep Black dial. The watch is covered by a 10-year warranty against material defects and inferior workmanship. Specifications: Case: surgical-grade (316L) stainless steel DLC-coated black coating (optional) sapphire crystal, domed, anti-reflective screw-down crown screw-locked caseback 43.5mm diameter 15mm height 22mm between lugs (strap size) water resistant to 20 atmospheres (200 meters/660 feet) Movement: ETA 2824 (Swiss Made)

watches.name: Soarway Diver 43
watches.description: The Soarway Diver 43 is rated to a water-resistance of 300 meters. It was created designed the help of a group of U.S. Navy SEALs who also helped test its reliability under water. The explorer Ranulph Fiennes also helped in the design of the Soarway Diver 43, and took ten prototypes of the 2013 Antarctic Winter Traverse in order to test the Soarway Diver's versatility in extremely cold environments. The Soarway Diver 43 arrives on a canvas band. The watch is covered by a 10-year warranty against material defects and inferior workmanship. ***Production of the Soarway Diver will resume in Quarter 1/2024 and has an 8-week delivery timeframe from the date of order.*** Specifications: Case: Kobold "Soarway" case surgical-grade (316L) stainless steel DLC-coated black coating (optional) sapphire crystal, domed, anti-reflective screw-down crown and chronograph push buttons screw-locked caseback 43mm diameter 15mm height 20mm between lugs (strap size) water resistant to 30 atmospheres (300 meters/1,000 feet) Movement: ETA 2824 (Swiss Made)

watches.name: Polar Bear Cufflinks
watches.description: Kobold's exquisite Polar Bear cufflinks are handmade in England from hallmark silver and genuine cloisonné enamel. Each cufflink consists of two halves depicting a polar bear on an ice floe, and each half has a different shade of blue for the polar ocean. The cufflinks are the ideal accessory for the civilized adventurer and perfectly match both Kobold's signature Arctic Blue dials and the Sir Ernest Shackleton's Atlantic Salmon dial.

watches.name: Breakfast At Everest
watches.description: Fly to Nepal on a Thursday, trek to Mount Everest and get back to work on a Monday. This excursion was designed for all those who have too little time for a full-blown expedition to the Himalayas. On arrival in Kathmandu, you will be escorted through the airport by a dedicated representative. As soon as you clear immigration in Kathmandu, we'll whisk you off to the Himalayas aboard a private helicopter (your luggage will be transferred automatically, so you won't waste time in the baggage claim.) Accompanied by a guide who has reached the summit of Mount Everest multiple times, you'll trek for three days, assisted by helicopters to skip the more mundane parts. Our guides will ensure that you bypass the paths crowded with tourists, so that you'll experience the Khumbu region in a more solitude manner. Along the way, you will stay in luxurious lodges with modern conveniences. On the last day, it's breakfast at the foot of Mount Everest, followed by a brisk trek down to the nearest village and a helicopter flight back to Kathmandu. You'll arrive just in time to catch your return flight to Europe or America. This excursion includes all accommodations, meals, transport (including domestic private air travel) and permit fees. Limited to four participants. Tours available in March, April, May, October and November. Price reflects four participants and increases with fewer participants.

watches.name: 30-Days Nepal by Motorcycle
watches.description: Experience Nepal in the most exhilarating way - by motorcycle and helicopter. We'll provide you with everything you need for the road trip of a lifetime, from a modern Royal Enfield Himalayan (411cc, 24.5 HP) to Nepal's most experienced motorcycle tour guide with over 50 years experience riding in the most rugged conditions. You'll see this beautiful country in all its majesty, from the lowlands in the Terai, to the foothills of the Himalayas, to the high Himalaya itself. You'll also fly to Mount Everest by helicopter aboard a modern aircraft piloted by one of Nepal's most experienced aviators, Captain Lama. Tented first class accommodations in remote regions, five-star hotel accommodations in major cities, first class meals, fuel, transportation (including private domestic air travel) and all permit fees included. Limited to 8 participants. Available in March and October.

watches.name: 14 Days Nepal
watches.description: Nepal spells adventure! At Kobold, we know Nepal better than anyone save the Nepalese themselves. Which is why we retain the most experienced and knowledgable local guides to make this exclusive trip a success. Discover the hidden treasures of the Kathmandu Valley with its many UNESCO World Heritage Sites. Experience the vibrant culture of Upper Mustang and trek in the remote regions of Eastern Nepal, faraway from the crowded trails popular among backpackers. You'll also fly to Mount Everest aboard a modern helicopter piloted by one of Nepal's most legendary aviators and receive a guided tour from a veteran mountaineer who's successfully summited Everest multiple times. Our tour guides speak fluent English, German, French, Nepali and Tibetan. Limited to ten participants. Available in March, April, October and November. Five-star lodging, transportation (including domestic air travel), first class meals included.
